name: Custom Shape Drawer Knobs
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
  • Wooden Knob is crafted from solid natural wood, that is sanded satin smooth. Pleasant to the touch and comfortable to grasp. It comes with a 2.6cm ~ 1.02 in screw.
  • Each faceplate's knob is crafted with high-quality materials, offering multiple finishes to match your style:

 - Wood: Natural, smooth-finish wooden base.

 - Transparent Acrylic: Durable clear acrylic with a glossy, modern look.

 - Starburst Acrylic: Acrylic with light-reflective effects for a dazzling shimmer.

 - Broken Glass Acrylic: Iridescent acrylic that reflects light like cracked glass for a vibrant, dynamic effect.

 - Mix Material (2 Layered): Combination of wood and acrylic for a dimensional, premium appearance.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
  • Available in multiple sizes to fit various furniture needs:
  • Design Sizes (Faceplate):

 - 2×2 inches ~ 5.08 × 5.08 cm

 - 3×3 inches ~ 7.62 × 7.62 cm

 - 4×4 inches ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm

  • Layer Thickness:

 - Single Layer: 3 mm

 - Double Layer: 6 mm total (3 mm per layer)

  • Knob Dimensions:

 - Knob Diameter: 3.5 cm ~ 1.38 in

 - Knob Height: 2.3 cm ~ 0.91 in

 - Knob Base Diameter: 2 cm ~ 0.79 in

 - Screw Length: 2.6 cm ~ 1.02 in

 - Screw Diameter: 0.3 cm ~ 0.12 in

 

  • Printing Technology:

 - UV Printing Technology: Delivers crisp, vibrant, and detailed images.

 - Double-Sided Printing: The design is printed on both front and back for a polished, finished look no matter the angle.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

 - These knobs are not just decorative—they are fully functional and compatible with most drawer or cabinet setups. Easy to install using the provided screws. Ideal for adding a unique, personalized touch to your dressers, kitchen drawers, bathroom cabinets, closets or wardrobes, cupboards, DIY furniture projects, etc.

 - The knobs fit most standard drawers and cabinets where the thickness of the drawer (where the knobs mount) is 10-14 mm (0.39-0.55 in)

 

  • A Thoughtful Gift for Any Occasion:

With customizable names and artwork, these knobs make a heartfelt and practical gift for any occasion: Housewarming parties, Veterans or patriotic celebrations, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Independence Day (4th of July), Birthdays and holidays or Anyone who loves personalized home décor.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Drawer Knobs

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
